title: vl16: leading sign of the generalised Laguerre polynomial L_2^s
reason: The printed polynomial has leading term -x^2/2. The finite-sum definition gives L_2^(s)(x) = x^2/2 - (s+2)x + (s+1)(s+2)/2; the printed one fails the Laguerre differential equation.
